prompt: Our healthcare startup is building a new backend service called 'medtrack' for managing patient records via a REST API. We have an internal environment provisioner tool already installed on the development server (under the `provisioner/` directory) that the team standardized on to avoid repeated boilerplate setup. I need you to use that tool to fully bootstrap the 'medtrack' backend project — making sure it's set up as a REST API project (not a plain web project), with properly separated settings for different environments, and a clean dependency structure. The provisioned project should end up in the `/workspace` directory. The tool will generate a `provisioner_manifest.json` file as part of the process — that file confirms everything was set up correctly.
